description: Castle Herend dating from 1500 near Budapest. Supposedly the home of Georgia O'Keeffe's relatives on her mother's side. Handwritten on verso: "The castle of Herend in Hungary. It was built in the XVI century by count Euldarhary [sp?]. Herend is in Hungary in the district of vepreus [sp?]." Handwritten on recto: "Castle of Herend near Budapest, built 1500 Totto home."
title: Castle Herend
